# Catho Clothing

> Heavyweight tees, caps and hoodies inspired by Catherine Hill Bay, NSW. Everyday essentials made for slow days by the coast.

Catho Clothing is an Australian merch brand dedicated to Catherine Hill Bay — the heritage coastal village south of Swansea, NSW. We make tees, caps and hoodies for people who love the bay.

- [Shop](/): The full collection — tees, caps and hoodies.
